Kara Game 3. te Champ instructions Training Use this session to learn and to practice the various moves. You can enter directly into game play by pressing either 1 or 2 player start button. Left Joystick controls player's direction of movement Right joystick controls player's choice of attack Both must be used together to execute the different moves. MATCH Maneuver YOUR PLAYER to fight against your opponent. Move joysticks to execute the various moves (see move chart) First fighter to score 2 points wins match Player advances to next level for each match won, BONUS INTERVAL After each match, play bonus rounds to score additonal points.
